run_experiment: run a click CLI command to test robot base motion navigating back and forth between two positions
load_config: load a Stretch robot pick-and-place environment configuration with optional visualization settings
StretchPickandPlaceEnv: create a Stretch robot pick-and-place environment instance with a config and ros_grasping flag
env_reset: reset the Stretch pick-and-place environment with specified object names like table, cup, and chair
navigate_to: navigate the robot base to a specified x, y, theta coordinate position
